items.name: Aam panna- ABV 5.5%
items.description: A refreshing honey-fermented mead infused with the tangy zing of traditional Aam Panna

items.name: Double Berry Mead - ABV 5.5%
items.description: Double Berry is a vibrant blend of blueberries and raspberries! Bright, fruit-forward, and gently tart, it opens with a lush berry aroma and finishes crisp and refreshing. A playful balance of sweetness and tang, made for easy sipping and moments that call for something colourful and lively.

items.name: IPA
items.description: Session IPA | ABV 6%. Light, crisp, and slightly fruity with orange and citrus-like flavors. Refreshing, mildly bitter, and super easy to sip even if you're new to craft beer.

items.name: Kadak Lager
items.description: Kadak Lager | ABV 8%. Our signature strong lager brewed with the perfect blend of rice and malt for a smooth, crisp finish. Bold yet clean, with an easy-drinking character that keeps you coming back for another sip.

items.name: Belgian Wit
items.description: Belgian Style Wit Beer | ABV 5%. Light, cloudy, and refreshing with soft citrus and subtle spice notes. Smooth, easy-drinking, and perfect for someone trying craft beer for the first time.

items.name: Guava Cider
items.description: Guava Cider | ABV 7%. Crisp, fruity, and slightly tangy with fresh guava notes and a smooth sparkling finish. Stronger than it feels, yet refreshing and super easy to sip.

items.name: Mango Cider
items.description: Mango Cider | ABV 5%. Fresh, fruity, and lightly sparkling with juicy mango notes and a crisp apple-cider finish. Smooth, refreshing, and perfect for people who enjoy lighter, easy-drinking beverages.

items.name: Coffee Orange Cider
items.description: Coffee Orange Cider | ABV 5%. A bold yet refreshing cider with bright orange citrus upfront and a smooth hint of coffee in the finish. Fruity, lightly sparkling, and surprisingly easy to drink.

items.name: Helles Lager
items.description: Helles Lager | ABV 8%. Smooth, clean, and strong with a light malty sweetness and crisp finish. Feels familiar like a classic strong beer, but fresher, softer, and much easier to drink without the harsh aftertaste.

items.name: Rize Lager Beer
items.description: Rize Lager | ABV 5%. Light, crisp, and ultra-refreshing with a smooth clean finish. Brewed with rice for an easy, lighter body — the kind of beer that feels simple, chilled, and endlessly drinkable.

items.name: Apple Cider
items.description: Apple Cider | ABV 6%. Crisp, refreshing, and lightly sparkling with fresh apple flavors and a smooth finish. Fruity, easy to drink, and perfect for those who enjoy lighter, refreshing beverages.

items.name: German Wheat - Hefeweizen
items.description: German Wheat Hefeweizen | ABV 5.5%. Smooth, cloudy, and refreshing with soft banana and clove-like notes. Light on bitterness, creamy on the palate, and super easy to enjoy even for first-time craft beer drinkers.

items.name: Stout
items.description: Stout | ABV 6%. Dark, smooth, and rich with roasted coffee and chocolate-like flavors. Creamy, slightly bold, and perfect for people who enjoy deeper, fuller-bodied beers.

items.name: Dunkelweizen
items.description: Dunkelweizen | ABV 8%. Dark, smooth, and mildly strong with notes of banana, roasted malt, and light caramel. A rich wheat beer that feels bold yet surprisingly smooth and easy to sip.

items.name: LAST WORKING DAY
items.description: Tomorrow Is Somebody Else's Problem. 🔥 KADAK ORIGINAL. LIIT + Kadak Lager. Hero drink.

items.name: FOUNDER MODE
items.description: Running On Caffeine And Delusion. 🔥 KADAK ORIGINAL. Classic LIIT finished with Coffee Orange Cider. Built for deadlines, pitch decks and questionable optimism. Dark. Citrusy. Wide Awake.

items.name: SCENE KYA HAI?
items.description: The Night Is Still Young. Classic LIIT topped with Guava Cider. Because some nights don't need introductions. Tropical. Tangy. Slightly Wild.

items.name: FULL TOSS
items.description: One More Round Sounded Like A Good Idea. Classic LIIT finished with Double Berry Cider. Berry Berry Mumbaiyaa!!!

items.name: Picante Guru's Way
items.description: Born In Mexico. Raised In India. Indian agave, fresh chilli and citrus. A global classic reimagined through local ingredients and a healthy disregard for convention.

items.name: PEACH, PLEASE
items.description: Looks innocent. Isn't — don't judge a drink by its colour. Very Kadak. Indian agave, peach and citrus.

items.name: PHILTER KAPI MARTINI
